recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Any future proposal to allow Person as a subject, performer, grantor, or other actor should be handled as a separate work-group policy change rather than as remaining work for FHIR-21241.
issue_request: FHIR-21241 was a Published PA change request with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It asked to emphasize that Person instances are never directly referenced as actors, add that Person SHALL NOT be referenced by other clinical or administrative resources, provide allowed infrastructure and prohibited clinical/administrative examples, and clarify that Practitioner can include people who are not licensed healthcare practitioners.
initial_application: Git commit 44ec49c38110e0301543132b063dc498bf6fc859, '#FHIR-21241 Make prohibited use of Person more obvious', applied the approved wording to source/person/person-introduction.xml. The Person resource is active in source/fhir.ini, so this file is current build source.
additional_context: The 2021-06-09 PA minutes record the same modified wording and 5-0-0 vote. Later no-change decisions FHIR-31723 and FHIR-36832 rejected attempts to use Person as a subject/actor in Observation and Consent contexts and cited the same Person boundary. Zulip threads show implementer confusion about Person as user or subject but no discovered reversal.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/person/person-introduction.xml lines 57-64 already contain the NEVER and SHALL NOT prohibition, examples of allowed operation/message/Bundle usage, prohibited List/Group/Observation usage, and the Practitioner clarification. A targeted search found no contradictory direct Reference(Person) source location outside Person.link.target, which is part of Person's own linkage model.
